decision.summary: A transient negative offset in N and U begins around index 415, with sustained deviation through 424 and only partial recovery; E exhibits a weaker, delayed dip without confirmed opposing return. The absence of a clear, full reversal on any axis before index 460 renders the interval uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported within [375, 460].

intervals.observation: N and U show a multi-sample negative excursion starting ~415, reaching ~−2 to −3 MAD; partial recovery observed by 424 but not full return to pre-event level. E shows a weaker, delayed dip (~418–422) without clear opposing motion or full reversal. Return is incomplete/ambiguous within allowed context.
